```yaml
name: Release to Maven Central & Docker Hub

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      version:
        description: 'Release version (e.g., 0.4.1)'
        required: true
        type: string
      dry_run:
        description: 'Dry run (build & validate only, no publish/push)'
        required: false
        type: boolean
        default: false

concurrency:
  group: release-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

env:
  MAVEN_OPTS: -Dmaven.repo.local=.m2/repository

jobs:
  validate-secrets:
    name: Validate Secrets
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Check required secrets
        run: |
          missing=()
          [[ -z "${{ secrets.SONATYPE_USERNAME }}" ]] && missing+=("SONATYPE_USERNAME")
          [[ -z "${{ secrets.SONATYPE_PASSWORD }}" ]] && missing+=("SONATYPE_PASSWORD")
          [[ -z "${{ secrets.GPG_PRIVATE_KEY }}" ]] && missing+=("GPG_PRIVATE_KEY")
          [[ -z "${{ secrets.GPG_PASSPHRASE }}" ]] && missing+=("GPG_PASSPHRASE")
          [[ -z "${{ secrets.DOCKERHUB_USER }}" ]] && missing+=("DOCKERHUB_USER")
          [[ -z "${{ secrets.DOCKERHUB_TOKEN }}" ]] && missing+=("DOCKERHUB_TOKEN")
          
          if [ ${#missing[@]} -gt 0 ]; then
            echo "::error::Missing required secrets: ${missing[*]}"
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "All required secrets are present."

  release:
    name: Build, Publish & Push
    needs: validate-secrets
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_TOKEN || secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set up JDK 17
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          java-version: '17'
          distribution: 'temurin'
          cache: maven

      - name: Set up Maven
        uses: stCarolas/setup-maven@v5
        with:
          maven-version: 3.9.6

      - name: Configure GPG
        run: |
          echo "${{ secrets.GPG_PRIVATE_KEY }}" | gpg --batch --import
          echo "${{ secrets.GPG_PASSPHRASE }}" > gpg-passphrase.txt
          chmod 600 gpg-passphrase.txt

      - name: Set up Docker Buildx
        uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v3

      - name: Login to Docker Hub
        if: ${{ !inputs.dry_run }}
        uses: docker/login-action@v3
        with:
          username: ${{ secrets.DOCKERHUB_USER }}
          password: ${{ secrets.DOCKERHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Build and Publish to Maven Central & Docker Hub
        env:
          SONATYPE_USERNAME: ${{ secrets.SONATYPE_USERNAME }}
          SONATYPE_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.SONATYPE_PASSWORD }}
          GPG_PASSPHRASE: ${{ secrets.GPG_PASSPHRASE }}
          DOCKERHUB_USER: ${{ secrets.DOCKERHUB_USER }}
          DOCKERHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.DOCKERHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          # Determine Maven goals based on dry_run input
          if [ "${{ inputs.dry_run }}" = "true" ]; then
            echo "Running in DRY RUN mode..."
            # Validate build and package, but do not deploy or push docker
            mvn clean package -B -V \
              -DskipTests \
              -Dgpg.skip=true \
              -Djib.skip=true
          else
            echo "Running in RELEASE mode..."
            # Deploy to Maven Central and Push to Docker Hub
            mvn clean deploy -B -V \
              -Prelease \
              -DskipTests \
              -Dgpg.passphrase="${{ secrets.GPG_PASSPHRASE }}" \
              -Dcentral.publishing=true
          fi

      - name: Update Documentation Versions
        if: ${{ !inputs.dry_run }}
        run: |
          VERSION="${{ inputs.version }}"
          echo "Updating documentation for version $VERSION"
          
          # Find all markdown files in documents/ and root
          find . -name "*.md" -type f | while read -r file; do
            # Skip CHANGELOG if it's auto-generated, or handle specifically if needed
            # Replace common patterns:
            # 1. Docker tags: rrobetti/ojp:0.x.y -> rrobetti/ojp:$VERSION
            # 2. JAR filenames: ojp-0.x.y.jar -> ojp-$VERSION.jar
            # 3. Maven coordinates: <version>0.x.y</version> -> <version>$VERSION</version>
            # 4. Maven Central URLs: /0.x.y/ -> /$VERSION/
            
            # Use sed to perform replacements in-place
            # Note: This is a simplified regex approach. Complex docs might need more specific handling.
            
            # Replace Docker image tags
            sed -i "s|rrobetti/ojp:[0-9]\+\.[0-9]\+\.[0-9]\+|rrobetti/ojp:${VERSION}|g" "$file"
            
            # Replace JAR filenames
            sed -i "s|ojp-[0-9]\+\.[0-9]\+\.[0-9]\+\.jar|ojp-${VERSION}.jar|g" "$file"
            
            # Replace Maven version tags in XML snippets
            sed -i "s|<version>[0-9]\+\.[0-9]\+\.[0-9]\+</version>|<version>${VERSION}</version>|g" "$file"
            
            # Replace Maven Central URL paths
            sed -i "s|/0\.[0-9]\+\.[0-9]\+/|/${VERSION}/|g" "$file"
            
            # Replace generic version references if they look like semantic versions in text
            # Be careful with this one to avoid replacing unrelated numbers
            # Example: "version 0.4.1" -> "version $VERSION"
            # This is risky, so we might skip it or make it very specific to the project name context
            # For now, we rely on the specific patterns above which are safer.
          done

      - name: Commit and Push Documentation Updates
        if: ${{ !inputs.dry_run }}
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          
          git add -A
          
          if ! git diff --staged --quiet; then
            git commit -m "docs: update version references to ${{ inputs.version }}"
            git push origin HEAD
          else
            echo "No documentation changes to commit."
          fi

      - name: Create GitHub Release
        if: ${{ !inputs.dry_run }}
        uses: softprops/action-gh-release@v2
        with:
          tag_name: ${{ inputs.version }}
          name: Release ${{ inputs.version }}
          generate_release_notes: true
          files: |
            ojp-server/target/ojp-${{ inputs.version }}.jar
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_TOKEN || secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Update Docker Hub Description
        if: ${{ !inputs.dry_run }}
        uses: peter-evans/dockerhub-description@v4
        with:
          username: ${{ secrets.DOCKERHUB_USER }}
          password: ${{ secrets.DOCKERHUB_TOKEN }}
          repository: rrobetti/ojp
          readme-filepath: ./README.md
```
